messages:
anna: quick sync on API credentials UX — updated flows in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/PROJ/credentials. key areas: reveal timing, rotate fallback copy, revoke undo, and empty-state affordances. jess: first-pass thoughts: the temporary reveal currently auto-closes after 4s which is bad for keyboard/sr users. proposal: keep reveal visible until user closes or copies; focus should land on the Copy button when revealed. sam: accessibility nit: do not expose the raw secret via live region. instead announce a success message: aria-live="polite" text: "New API key created and copied to clipboard." keep the secret in a visually-hidden container only if absolutely necessary. mike: copy tweak for the create modal: current: "This is the only time you'll see the secret. Save it now." suggestion: "Save this API key now — it cannot be retrieved later." shorter and clearer. anna: about revoke flow: recommend soft-delete for 24 hours with an undo toast rather than immediate hard revoke. reduces support tickets and accidental lockouts. toast copy: "API key revoked. Undo" (undo available for 24h). jess: UI/UX detail: keep revoke modal compact — collapse extended explanations under "Why revoke?" accordion. tab order inside modal: cancel -> optional reason -> revoke. pressing esc returns focus to the row in the list. sam: add animation + aria announce when undo is clicked: announce "API key restoration successful" via polite live region. test with NVDA + VO. mike: rotate fallback: if rotation fails, surface a persistent banner: "Rotation failed — previous key still active. Retry or contact support." include Retry button and link to docs. anna: suggestion for credential list: show a subtle banner for keys >180 days: "Keys older than 180 days are recommended for rotation" with a one-click filter to find them. jess: implementation checklist for frontend: 1) reveal stays until dismissed or copy clicked; 2) Copy gets initial focus; 3) keyboard toggle (space/enter) to reveal; 4) storybook stories for sr + keyboard flows. sam: sample aria snippet to use on copy success: ```
New API key created and copied to clipboard.
``` ensure copy button updates a separate live region rather than inserting the secret. mike: RBAC note: show inline permission hint inside rotate/revoke modals when user lacks rights: "You need admin access to rotate keys — request access or contact your admin." link to docs. deploy-bot: design/credentials branch updated: "credentials/reveal-undo-rotate" (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/234). anna: ok assigning: jess -> storybook + modal focus changes; sam -> axe test list + accessibility doc; mike -> update copy in docs + RBAC hint; i'll prototype the soft-delete toast animation. will review in design sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
